prompt.default: Use my Amber Notes note "Job hunt". When I paste a job ad or a link, add a row with log_table_row: Company, Role, Stage Saved, and the Link. When I tell you I applied or heard back, update that row's Stage and Next step with edit_note (read the note with read_note first). Before an interview, add five likely questions and my talking points under "Interview prep" with append_to_note, under a "###" heading with the company name. When I ask what's next, list the follow-ups under "This week" as a checklist.

asks: Save this one: Senior designer at Northwind, …
I have a first interview with Northwind on Thursday. Help me prep.
What should I follow up on this week?

args.text:
- [ ] Send the portfolio link to Northwind
- [ ] Follow up with Fabrikam on Wednesday

### Northwind
1. Walk us through a project you're proud of. *The onboarding redesign: 18% more activation.*
2. How do you work with engineers? *Weekly reviews, shared Figma, ship small.*
3. Why Northwind? *Their logistics tools are the kind of complex I like.*
